Oort lists the games that nx2android installed on this device: apps whose package starts with org.nx2a. Port your own games on a computer with nx2android, then install them here. Oort contains no game, no key and no emulator.
The game\'s own settings (gamepad, frame rate, audio, saves) are in its pause menu: the Back gesture, or the controller\'s Menu button.
Uninstalling a game also deletes its saves. Export them first: pause menu, Game tab, Export save.
No controller connected. Pair one over Bluetooth, or plug it in.
Android names buttons by label, so A confirms and B goes back. If your controller has the Switch layout, turn on “Swap A and B” in the settings.
Made on the device, with no audio file.
For a controller with the Switch layout.
A still cloud. It follows Android\'s “Remove animations” until you choose.
MIT license. Local only: this app asks Android for no network access and collects nothing.
Starts games made by nx2android (shirai91, MIT), the Android port of nxnative (seedds, MIT). The cloud and the sounds come from Oort NX for Mac. See NOTICE for the full credits.
